title: Choose the visual world for Rafuna Consulting
question: The roll assigned Ulpiana Mosaic. Keep it, take my pick or an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Ulpiana Mosaic
options.lineage: Roman floor mosaics of Ulpiana, the ancient city the firm's Ulpiane neighbourhood is named for
options.thesis: Thousands of small entries set by hand until the whole picture is clear: the firm's work, shown as a mosaic.
materials: grout lines on a strict module grid
options.viewport: Navy field; the logo's three chevrons laid in ~1,800 tesserae across the right two-thirds, running off the edge; monumental headline left with Call, WhatsApp and Book under it.
options.risk: Reads as a museum or a tile shop if the grid goes loose or the type is timid.

raised.raise: The mosaic is laid once, in one pass, on load; nothing loops or re-animates for decoration.
Form states (sending, booked, error) print into the page in the mosaic's type, never as toasts.
Every figure is set in tabular lining numerals with its unit, like a batch card beside each sample.
One display face at monumental scale carries the hero; no second display voice.
The hero mosaic breaks past the viewport edge and continues across a grout seam into the next section.
No two sections share a composition; each is a different arrangement on the same module grid.

options.label: Intaglio Banknote
options.lineage: euro banknotes, share certificates and guilloche security printing
options.thesis: The firm's promise engraved like currency: precision that cannot be forged.
options.viewport: A guilloche rosette in navy, teal and orange lines engraves itself behind a serial-numbered headline, with Call, WhatsApp and Book set as certificate fields.
options.risk: Banks and fintechs already use this move, so it can read as a currency costume.

options.label: Ebru Ledger Edge
options.lineage: ebru floated-pigment marbling, once used on ledger edges so a removed page would show
options.thesis: Marbled navy, teal and orange pigment combed into the logo's chevrons, as tamper-evident as an old ledger's edge.
options.viewport: A full-bleed marbled sheet combed into chevrons, headline set on the lifted paper.
options.case: Fuses with a real ledger fact but loses both axes: visitors read art, not accounting, and fewer of them know ebru than know Ulpiana.
options.risk: Heavy fluid simulation on mid-range phones.
options.kept: One-pass, irreversible making: the mosaic is laid once and never loops.

options.label: Phosphor Ledger Terminal
options.thesis: The books as a live transcript on glass.
options.viewport: An 80-column transcript printing the firm's services line by line.
options.case: Loses both axes: no business owner looks for a trusted accountant in a terminal, and luxury is gone.
options.kept: System states print themselves into the page instead of appearing as chrome.

options.label: Glaze Shelf
options.lineage: kiln shelves of glazed test cups
options.thesis: Services as glazed samples ranked on one shelf.
options.viewport: A row of glazed cups, each a service, with batch cards below.
options.case: Loses both axes: no link between ceramics and accounting.
options.kept: Batch-card numerals: every figure set tabular with its unit.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.thesis: Words like TVSH and TAK condense and break into weather.
options.viewport: Tax acronyms gathering into a storm over a white field.
options.case: Loses both axes: playful chaos is the opposite of what a client wants from their accountant.
options.kept: One monumental display face carrying the hero.

options.label: Vinyl Wrap
options.thesis: The brand mark wrapped across panels with sponsor strips.
options.viewport: The logo scaled across panel seams with a sponsor strip of services.
options.case: Loses both axes: motorsport loudness undercuts trust.
options.kept: Artwork scaled so large it breaks across a seam into the next panel.

options.label: Bolted Futurist Book
options.viewport: Angled wood-type headlines slamming across a cream page.
options.case: Loses both axes: shouting is the wrong voice for an accountant.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A premium accounting-firm site, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and photo split hero, service cards, trust strip, contact form.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other firm by design.
